ios.desc:
Stop spending more time choosing what to watch than actually watching it.

Film Finder is the social hub for film and tv lovers, designed to help you discover great films and shows faster while connecting you with friends who share your taste.

Whether you're searching for your next movie night, building watchlists with friends, or tracking every film you've seen, Film Finder brings everything together in one place.

Make film social
- Follow friends and discover what they're watching
- Create collaborative watchlists together
- Explore public profiles and watchlists from other film lovers

Discover your next favourite film
- Find great films and TV shows in seconds
- Browse by genre, category, cast, crew, and more
- Watch trailers without leaving the app
- See ratings, summaries, and key information at a glance
- Filter by streaming platform to find what's actually available to watch

Track your film journey
- Log films you've watched
- Write reviews and rate your favourites
- Import your Letterboxd data and pick up where you left off

Join the community
- View previous and upcoming Film Finder Club screenings
- Showcase screenings on your profile
- Connect with fellow film lovers both online and offline

Less scrolling. Less indecision. More great films.

Download Film Finder today and discover your next favourite watch.

quotes.text:
We’ve just launched Film Finder to the App Store. It's an app that recommends films to people based on their preferences.

Here’s the link: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/film-finder/id1625393761

We'll be improving the app regularly, so follow our journey here:

https://linktr.ee/filmfinder.uk

Our background is in Film, Business, and Tech so it’s been fun working on this.

--

App Features

REELS (FILTERS) – Find exactly what you’re looking for

Create a search criteria through our ‘reels’ feature. We’ll then provide you with a range of film recommendations based on this

Criterions include: cast, crew, genre, popular, and trending

RECS - Choose from our recommendations

Whether you decide to create super-specific reels, more general reels, or no reels at all, Film Finder will provide you with film recommendations

You can save films to your watchlists (and other folders), rate them, and share them

PROFILE - Manage your watchlists, favourites, and more

Create watchlist folders and save films to them. Can’t be bothered to create a watchlist folder? Add films to your ‘Watchlists’ section as a singular title instead of a folder!

Do you have films that you’d like to recommend to friends and family? Why not save those film recommendations to your ‘My Recs’ section?

SEARCH - Search for specific films or talent

Find film cards by searching titles

Find actor and crew profiles by searching their names

NOTIFICATIONS - Get your latest updates and alerts
